title: THE BIZARRE HEIST THAT ROCKED PARIS

scenes.text: In 2009, a thief stole a $1 million painting from a gallery.
The thief entered during an exhibition, blending in perfectly.
Despite the painting's recovery two years later, the thief remains unidentified.
The criminal's identity remains a mystery.
Follow if you'd have cracked this one.

description: A daring heist at a Paris gallery saw a $1 million painting stolen right under the noses of art lovers, and the thief remains a mystery. Join us to uncover the details! #shorts #Paris #artheist #unsolved #fyp
